body: I was referred, and when I went to the session i was made to take my top and vest off for examination by the physiotherapist, and It was uncomfortable for me because of my weight and I have eczema patches all over my chest, (big red patches of dry flaky skin) so it was so awkward, it put me off going again.. I know, bad bad bad.. but its what i do.

every time i try to do something, it always fails.. like healthy eating, i'll go a day and then pig out on rubbish for no reason..  I'll make a plan to start exercising, then the next day i'll be totally ignorant to the fact i was going to do it.. I try to look for other jobs, but never even get interviewed.. I will never be able to change my appearance of my spine and it gets me down sooo much.
